none: PAS CAM-945244: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine - CONSTANTINOPOLIS
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine - CONSTANTINOPOLIS. Mint is uncertain, AD330-340, (Reece period 17). Reverse shows Victory standing left on prow. Obverse shows helmeted bust left. Obverse legend reads ( CONSTANTINOPOLIS ). Condition is fair, die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight 1.53g, diameter 17.74mm
